scope.method: Independent reading of the proposed documentation diff, retained guides/evidence and relevant runtime/test source. File hashing only; no product import or execution.

checks.observation: The plan correctly identifies complete admitted committed-source byte replay as implemented, backed by retained originals and deterministic KEEP/DELETE maps. This is distinct from filesystem export.

The complete committed-source inventory is distinguished from the worker manifest population capped at 64 files and 1 MiB, with unsupported files passed through and Gitlink contents an explicit separate frontier.

The current display transform preserves path identity, identifiers, imports, string contents, indentation and physical lines. Default comment preservation and opt-in comment removal are correctly distinguished from symbol/path/literal renaming.

Unchanged replay is distinguished from edit propagation. Edited compact views refuse; proposed mapped-span edits require independent preimage and original/view identities and preserve untouched bytes.
The plan does not claim an executable minified checkout. Import/reflection/tooling equivalence remains a separate qualification profile; original-source execution is retained.
Working refresh does not admit new paths or provide arbitrary move/delete support. Candidate artifacts remain session-local and do not publish accepted indexes or reuse proofs.

A representation receipt is explicitly proposed. Additive tooling is not called displaced source. Delivered inputs can verify replaced spans; avoided future reads remain counterfactual and require matched complete runs.

The plan counts the complete rendered representation with a compatible coding-provider counter and exact-source fallback, rather than substituting bytes, Python lexical tokens or GTE tokens for provider tokens.

Final native input plus output is aggregated across actual LLM sessions. Provider-included tool text, reasoning and cached-input subsets are not added again; local computation remains a separate ledger.

The plan correctly distinguishes the older negative compact-transport result, the single instruction-deduplication pair, and provider-free selected formal retrieval. None is presented as repeatable compact-source token savings.

IR routing roles are proposed supported subsets, with family/schema/task/dimension/window identities retained. Existing assets are reused where pinned profiles match, missing profiles remain explicit, and semantic training loss does not certify exact byte restoration.

The plan retains unfinished native bootstrap/context/actual-child and source-CAS integration prerequisites. Repository discovery and displacement measurement precede aggressive mapped/executable minification.

resolved_wording_findings.resolution: Accepted formal-index publication still needs its separate boundary.

resolved_wording_findings.previous_wording: A declared displacement is a proposal until the actually delivered input and native usage confirm it.
resolved_wording_findings.resolution: The delivered input confirms replaced spans; avoided future reads remain counterfactual and require matched complete runs.

limits: This is documentation/source inspection and readback of historical evidence, not a new runtime, exact-replay, model-quality, provider-token or task-success qualification.
Existing test and Docker results retain their original source and authored-worker scopes; this review did not rerun them.

The IR-routing review checks conceptual separation, preservation and proposed roles; current UI/UX checkpoint/publication evidence is covered by the separate family audit and was not re-executed here.
The source bindings cover the listed directly inspected files rather than a complete dependency closure.
